# vendor/

Patched third-party crates, used as path dependencies through `[patch.crates-io]` or the
workspace dependency table in the root `Cargo.toml`.

| Crate | Upstream | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `iced_aw` | https://github.com/iced-rs/iced_aw | MIT (see `iced_aw/LICENSE`) |
| `iced_fonts` | https://github.com/Redhawk18/iced_fonts | MIT (see `iced_fonts/LICENSE`) |

## Scope of the checks

`vendor/` sits outside the `license-guard` clean-room grep and the file-size gate; both only
look at `crates/**`. Review changes here by hand.

## Fonts

Only one font file is compiled in: `iced_aw/font.ttf` (`ICED_AW_FONT_BYTES`), a Fontello
build with six glyphs: `cancel`, `down-open`, `left-open`, `right-open`, `up-open`, `ok`.
Those names match the Fontello Entypo set (CC BY 4.0, Daniel Bruce); the build carries no
per-glyph licence record, so confirm the source set before shipping a release.

`iced_fonts` ships no font files: every `include_bytes!` in its `src/lib.rs` is behind a
feature (`bootstrap`, `codicon`, `devicon`, `fontawesome`, `lucide`, `nerd`, `octicons`,
`pomicons`), and `iced_aw` enables only `advanced_text`. The font files and the showcase
images were removed because they were never compiled in and several carried licences the
repo does not accept (codicon CC BY 4.0, FontAwesome OFL 1.1 without its licence text,
`nerd.ttf` bundling codicons). Enabling one of those features needs the font file and its
licence text added back first.

## Cargo.toml headers

`*/Cargo.toml` still carry the "AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO" header, but they are
hand-edited and the `Cargo.toml.orig` next to them is not kept in step.
